add.title: Add a web widget
add.body: Show a web page on Home. Pages at a Hoody computer's address show inside the card; other sites get a button that opens them in a new tab.
add.name: Name (optional)
add.refused.scheme: Type a full address that starts with http:// or https://
add.refused.bad: This address can't be read. Check it for spaces or typing mistakes.
add.refused.credentials: Take the user name and password out of the address.
add.refused.hub: Hub pages can't be added as widgets.
add.nameBad: Use up to 40 characters, without line breaks.
add.full: This realm has 12 web widgets, the most it can hold. Remove one to add another.
add.noRealm: Choose a realm first: web widgets are kept per realm.
add.lost: A web widget you added could not be kept: another tab filled this realm's 12 places first.
toast.notKept: This change to your web widgets couldn't be saved in this browser.
card.blocked: This site can't be shown here.
card.blockedBody: Only pages at a Hoody computer's address show inside Home. Open this one in a new tab.
card.slow: Still loading. Some sites don't allow being shown inside other pages.
rename.title: Rename widget
rename.label: Name
rename.hint: Leave it empty to show the site's address.
remove.title: Remove this widget?
remove.body: {{name}} and its address are removed from Home in this realm.
